author: Mouses007
name: AutarkTrade Positions
description: Desktop widget for AutarkTrade (formerly Crypto Trading Journal). Shows open Bitunix/Bitget futures positions and running Pionex bots with live PnL, plus a price chart. Requires a running AutarkTrade instance (github.com/Mouses007/AutarkTrade).
comments: Positions, bots, PnL in USDT or %, grid profit, price chart (line/candles, 24 h / 7 d), HTTPS with certificate pinning. Configurable refresh interval, columns, font sizes and appearance.
